ns2:section.sectionText: IAN HOBSON PIANO MASTERCLASS. This course is open to students who would like to participate in a half-hour piano masterclass with Ian Hobson. Six masterclasses are scheduled for Fall 2019: (1) September 13 from 10:00 am–12:30 pm in FGH in KCPA; (2) September 13 from 2:30–5:00 pm in FGH in KCPA; (3) October 16 from 11:00 am–1:30 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall; (4) October 17 from 1:30–4:00 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall; (5) November 19 from 9:30 am–12:00 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall; (6) November 21 from 1:30-4:00 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall.
